histoire.title: Our Story
histoire.launch: October 1st, 2026 marks the international commercial launch of Édouard Patrick Junior Onana's infalsifiable seal — a multilayer document security solution now distributed worldwide by the First of All brand.
histoire.intro: We tell you its origin, its uniqueness, its philosophy, its business model and its official timeline, from creation to launch.

invention.title: PRESENTATION OF THE INVENTION
invention.text: The infalsifiable seal is a physical and digital device combining advanced cryptography, fiduciary security and digital technologies to make falsification or reproduction practically impossible. It protects the authenticity of official documents (governments, banks, universities, healthcare, commerce).
invention.inventor: Invented by Édouard Patrick Junior Onana, recognized in African and international press and global intellectual property organizations as a pioneer in document security.

protection.title: TECHNICAL FEATURES
protection.subtitle: The 9 Levels of Protection
protection.intro: The strength of this technology lies in the superposition of nine independent and complementary security layers, making any reproduction impossible:

levels.name: Visible Fiduciary Securities
levels.desc: Design elements and specific inks inspired by banknotes, detectable to the naked eye.

levels.name: Invisible Fiduciary Securities
levels.desc: Components inserted into the medium (paper or seal) requiring specific tools to be revealed.

levels.name: Digital Cryptography
levels.desc: Integration of a unique digital key or identifier linked to each document via a secure architecture (blockchain type).

levels.name: Specific Calibration
levels.desc: Security elements are precisely calibrated for a given document type.

levels.name: Temporal Authentication
levels.desc: The seal can be configured to be valid only during a defined period.

levels.name: Indestructible Document Link
levels.desc: If the seal is affixed to a document for which it was not intended, the invisible security instantly proves fraud.

levels.name: Total Traceability
levels.desc: Each imprint or seal is traceable to its origin and its legitimate holder.

levels.name: Anti-Usurpation
levels.desc: In the event of theft of the physical seal, it becomes unusable as the fraudster does not possess the context information necessary for its validity.

levels.name: Instant Verification
levels.desc: A validation system allows any inspector (via smartphone or reader) to confirm the integrity of the 8 previous levels simultaneously.

histoire.philosophy: Integrity, authenticity, responsibility. The project aims not only to counter fraud but also to restore trust in documentary exchanges. The limited annual production reflects a desire for ethical exclusivity: quality, strict partner control and compliance with international standards.
commerce: Partner selection: public and private institutions respecting integrity standards.
Annual limited series: 5,000 Essential; 2,000 Business; 1,000 Executive; 50 Exclusive; 10 Exclusive+ (controlled global distribution).
histoire.structure: First of All — positioned as the premium reference in document security. Commercial implantation: commercial entities established in the United States, United Kingdom and Canada; selective distribution network and institutional partnerships for integration into administrative and financial processes.
histoire.vision: To become the global reference for decision-makers' seal authenticity, combining technological innovation and ethics. Objective: significantly reduce documentary fraud and establish international standards of trust.
